$description: Capsule tokens — W3C DTCG. Capsule is the e-ink successor to Lokta and keeps Lokta's public role names so an app swaps the token layer without rewriting components. Three layers: primitive (raw, never consumed by product code), semantic (roles), stock (re-points semantic so theming inherits compliance). Palette: Flexoki by Steph Ango (MIT), extended with two darkened stops (cyan-700, green-700) so a pigment can serve as body-size ink and as a fill with reversed text from one value. Contrast ratios in $description are measured by validate/contrast-gate.mjs against the WCAG 2.x relative-luminance formula, not hand-entered.

primitive.$description: Raw values. Product code must never reference these directly — only the semantic layer.

paper.$description: Flexoki paper. Positive-polarity ground. Never #FFFFFF — real e-ink white is ~44% reflectance and warm.

black.$description: Flexoki black. Ink foreground. Never #000000 — pigment is not pure.

100.$description: Inset surface on paper; primary text on slate (13.5:1).

200.$description: 1.3:1 on paper — decorative only; Capsule retires it, since Capsule has one line.

600.$description: 5.0:1 on paper — the single line, and the lowest passing text tier.
6.4:1 on paper — focus ring, info fill.

400.$description: 4.4:1 on slate — focus ring and non-text UI only.

600.$description: 4.4:1 on paper — fails body text; superseded by green-700.

700.$description: 5.2:1 on paper — success ink and fill.

600.$description: 4.4:1 on paper — fails body text; superseded by cyan-700.

700.$description: 6.0:1 on paper as ink AND 6.0:1 reversed as a fill — the accent.

600.$description: 7.6:1 on paper — feature ink and fill.
6.2:1 on paper — failure and destructive confirmation only.

400.$description: 4.0:1 on slate — large text and non-text only.

space.$description: Lokta's nine-step scale, kept verbatim. Capsule inherits it rather than re-indexing, so an app's existing --space-N references keep their meaning.

surface.$description: Panels, cards, sheets, rails, dividers, thumbnails — surfaces are square. Gated to 0.

control.$description: Chips, tags, toggles — detached pressable controls only. Lint allows this value only on control classes.

rule.$description: One line weight. Lokta's 0.5px hairline retires: e-ink has no line-weight hierarchy.

sans.$description: Humanist grotesque. CHROME ONLY — nav, controls, table rows, meta — at 400/500. Never the display voice: a slightly condensed grotesque set large and heavy is the harshest thing that can sit on a warm ground, which is why Capsule demotes it. Self-hosted OFL binaries; no CDN.

read.$description: The display AND reading voice: headlines, page titles, card titles, long-form prose. Ships 400 and 600 only — there is deliberately no heavier weight to reach for. Self-hosted OFL binaries; no CDN. (Capsule adopts Source Serif 4 rather than Newsreader because adamr.io already vendors it — one fewer binary, same role.)

label.$description: Tracked labels, folios, dates, figures. The device-caption voice.

data.$description: Datatype variable font (Frank Tisellano, OFL). Inline bar/line/pie charts via 'liga'+'calt' ligature substitution — ink only, no colour, survives the grayscale gate. The raw expression stays legible if the font fails to load.

semantic.$description: Roles consumed by product code. Point at primitives; a stock re-points them. Names match Lokta's public layer.

body.$description: e-ink body is full ink, not a softened grey.

disabled.$description: Large/non-text only; the dimming comes from --state-disabled-opacity, not a fourth grey.

raised.$description: Alias of page. Capsule has no elevation; --scrim is the only depth cue.

inverted.$description: Solid ink fill for MODES only — active rail entry, contextual bars, section openers. Reversed paper text rides it at 18.6:1.

paper.$description: Paper veil behind popups — fades the page, never a dark overlay or shadow. Page colour at 0.62 alpha; per-stock.

hatch.$description: 1-bit texture for the PROVISIONAL/PENDING state. Survives the grayscale gate; must sit beside a text label (never meaning-alone, 1.4.1) and never under body text.

hairline.$description: The single line. One weight (1px), one colour, used for every divider, card, table rule and frame.

default.$description: Alias of hairline. Lokta's three-tier line hierarchy collapses to one.

control.$description: Gated at 3:1 (1.4.11) — base-600 is 5.0:1 on paper.

strong.$description: Alias; retained so product code can request emphasis without introducing a second weight.

ink.$description: Pigment on the page — links and active marks. Verified at body size, so it needs no separate '-ink' variant. Never the sole carrier of meaning (1.4.1).

stock.$description: A stock re-points the semantic layer. Both stocks pass every gate; neither is claimed calmer. Lokta's bone / ink / indigo selectors alias onto these two in the built CSS.
